title: Minimum Domino Rotations For Equal Row
summary: Given a row of dominoes with tops[i] and bottoms[i] representing each domino's halves, determine the minimum rotations needed to make all tops or all bottoms the same.
statement: Given a row of dominoes with tops[i] and bottoms[i] representing each domino's halves, determine the minimum rotations needed to make all tops or all bottoms the same. If impossible, return -1.
constraints: Both rows have equal nonzero length and values 1..6.
Return the fewest rotations making either row constant, or -1.
hints: Any common value must appear on both halves of the first domino.
For a candidate reject any domino lacking it; otherwise count top and bottom rotations and take the minimum.
No other value can cover the first domino, so the two candidates are exhaustive.
editorial: No other value can cover the first domino, so the two candidates are exhaustive.

tests.explanation: Making every top a two needs two rotations.
Neither first-domino candidate occurs on every domino.
